situations.label: Paid-campaign marketer
situations.guidance: Consider Unbounce when you need campaign-specific landing pages and want to test page variants instead of sending every visitor to one static page.

situations.label: Team that needs controlled experiments
situations.guidance: A stronger fit when A/B testing is part of the workflow and you need to compare landing-page variants using conversion goals.

situations.label: Team that wants automated traffic optimization
situations.guidance: Consider the Smart Traffic workflow when routing visitors across multiple page variants is more useful than choosing one universal page for everyone.

situations.label: Lowest-cost landing page is the main priority
situations.guidance: Compare alternatives before committing. COSHUMA should not treat Unbounce as the default choice when entry price matters more than experimentation and optimization features.

problems: Campaign teams need dedicated landing pages without depending on developers for every page change.
Marketers need to compare landing-page variants instead of relying on one untested campaign page.
A team wants a repeatable landing-page optimization workflow with conversion goals, testing and reporting.
